terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: The rules for using Pistaklero. Written in plain language on purpose.

service.title: What Pistaklero is
service.body: A job board that connects people looking for work with companies that post jobs with visible salaries. Pistaklero is not a party to the employment relationship between them.

accounts.title: Accounts and roles
accounts.body: Each account is either a candidate or a company account, and the role can't be changed. You are responsible for what happens with your account: don't share it.

companies.title: Rules for companies
companies.body: Jobs must be real, state a true salary and never ask applicants for money or bank details. Companies commit to replying to applications: Pistaklero publicly shows how long they take.

candidates.title: Rules for applicants
candidates.body: The information in your profile must be true. You can apply up to 20 times per day and withdraw an application whenever you want.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.body: Any account can report a job. With 3 reports, the job is hidden until we review it. We may suspend accounts or companies that break these rules.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We do our best to keep information reliable, but we don't guarantee the outcome of any hiring process. Be wary of any job that asks you for money, and report it.

changes.title: Changes and contact
changes.body: If we change these terms, we'll announce it on the site. Questions: {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What data we store, why, and what you can do with it.

data.title: What data we store
data.body: Your email and, depending on your role, your profile or company data, your applications and their history. We don't ask for ID numbers, date of birth, gender, marital status or photos.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.body: So you can apply or post jobs, and to email you about changes to your applications or your team. We don't sell data or use it for advertising.

visibility.title: Who sees what
visibility.body: By default, your profile is visible only to registered companies; you can make it public or hide it. Companies you block never see it. Your salary expectation is private unless you choose to share it with the companies you apply to.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We only use essential cookies: your session cookie (protected, site code can't read it), your language and your theme (light or dark). No tracking or third-party cookies.

providers.title: Providers
providers.body: Data is hosted on Supabase and the site on Vercel. Emails are sent with Resend. To import jobs from other sites we use Claude (Anthropic) only with the text of those jobs, never with candidates' data.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: From Settings you can download all your data and delete your account. You can also correct it from your profile. Your rights are protected by Argentina's Law 25,326 and, if you are in the European Union, by the GDPR. Questions: {email}.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: While your account exists. If you delete it, your data is removed immediately, except a minimal security log without personal data.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: We want anyone to be able to search for jobs and apply on Pistaklero.

goal.title: Our goal
goal.body: To meet the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA: usable with only a keyboard, with screen readers and with zoom, with verified color contrast.

verification.title: How we verify it
verification.body: Every change goes through automated accessibility tests (axe) in Spanish and English, and we review the main flows with a keyboard and screen readers.

limitations.title: Known limitations
limitations.body: Some "not found" pages need JavaScript to display. We're working on fixing it.

contact.title: Tell us if you find a barrier
contact.body: If something doesn't work for you, email us at {email} and we'll fix it.
